material_news_signals.headline: Rams WR Puka Nacua likely to be placed on injured reserve with turf toe, sprained MCL and PCL
material_news_signals.description: Rams wide receiver Puka Nacua is likely to be placed on injured reserve after suffering a turf toe injury and spraining his MCL and PCL in Sunday's 20-13 win over the Commanders, head coach Sean McVay said Monday.
material_news_signals.body_text: the rams have lost another star to injury wide receiver puka nacua is likely to be placed on injured reserve after suffering a turf toe injury and spraining his mcl and pcl in sunday s 20 13 win over the commanders head coach sean mcvay said monday i m bummed for puka mcvay said i feel for him i feel for all of our players that are getting these kinds of injuries it s challenging but it s an opportunity for us to adjust and adapt the game s gonna be played but you feel for the players first and foremost nacua a two time pro bowler has 70 receptions for 715 yards and four touchdowns in seven games this season in the outing against washington he was targeted 19 times with 150 yards and a score on 14 catches this marks the latest in a lengthy list of ailments for nacua this season as he was affected by psoas soreness throughout training camp and sat weeks 2 and 3 due to a hip injury but the turf toe and knee sprain will lead to his longest absence yet nacua is set to join fellow star wideout davante adams hamstring on ir leaving the rams with a wr corps of tutu atwell konata mumpfield jordan whittington and cj daniels plus a tight end group of tyler higbee colby parkinson and davis allen that is frequently used in the passing attack it remains to be seen when tight end terrance ferguson might rejoin that group the most athletic with perhaps the highest ceiling of los angeles tight ends he initially was expected to come off ir for week 9 after recovering from an ankle injury only to hurt his hamstring during friday s practice though l a has dealt with the absence of many big names on both sides of the ball nacua missing extended time will prove especially detrimental to a rams offense that hasn t clicked at all times in 2026 over the past two games matthew stafford has thrown for 385 yards two touchdowns and two interceptions hardly looking like the mvp quarterback he was in 2025 and lacking other difference making pass catchers becoming laser focused on nacua to keep things moving nacua saw a 48 target share in week 8 against the chargers and a 44 2 share on sunday meaning the rams will have to compensate for nearly half of their recent passing offense now gone should nacua go on ir as mcvay expressed is likely he will miss the next four games plus a bye week against the cardinals packers chiefs and 49ers before being eligible to return in week 15 against the cowboys

material_news_signals.headline: Bills-Vikings on 'Monday Night Football': What We Learned from Buffalo's 23-6 win over Minnesota
material_news_signals.description: NFL.com's Bobby Kownack breaks down the Bills' victory over the Vikings on Monday night.
material_news_signals.body_text: allen weathers minnesota s blitz for win the league s no 1 scoring offense faced off against the no 1 scoring defense on monday night and for most of the first half the defense won soundly vikings defensive coordinator brian flores did his thing sending blitzers screaming toward josh allen with reckless abandon to great success through buffalo s first six drives which netted the bills 63 yards three points and an interception allen went 4 of 9 for 31 yards an interception and a 13 9 passer rating against the blitz he was pressured on seven of those dropbacks facing a blitz and sacked thrice and at times seemed capable only of chucking it deep in the face of a relentless rush but as time went on the bills began to get to the vikings both through a shorter hitting offense and perhaps mentally as buffalo erased any good minnesota s defense did by dominating its outclassed offense the bills gutted out an eight play 80 yard drive on their seventh possession allen finished it by dancing around for 6 07 seconds per next gen stats before heaving a 25 yard touchdown strike to a wide open keleki latu the tight end s first target of the season and first score of his career in a sense that s exactly how the bills won they waited out and wore out the vikings defense during a grueling night winning the time of possession battle 42 32 to 17 28 james cook jumped from 33 yards on 15 carries at halftime to 107 yards and a score on 31 totes by game s end while allen added 112 yards on his 11 second half throws after managing only 122 over his first 20 the vikings defense didn t do much wrong they just couldn t do everything right all night without a semblance of help on the other side wentz disaster class wastes flores masterclass kyler murray s hamstring injury opened up the possibility that carson wentz might step up in prime time and prove himself a more effective quarterback for minnesota s offense which had struggled to find much traction under the two time pro bowler he did the exact opposite of that ridding vikings fans of any notion that there was a qb on the bench who represented a better option facing the 30th ranked defense against the pass wentz delivered a miserable performance he missed pass catchers short high and wide he threw one interception deep to t j hockenson where only bills linebacker dorian williams could catch it and another one directly to lb terrel bernard while trying to hit justin jefferson he went 3 of 8 on short throws 0 9 yards air yards and 3 of 13 on anything deeper than that finishing 8 of 25 overall for 81 yards and an 8 9 passer rating the lowest by any qb to attempt at least 25 passes in a game since sam darnold s 3 6 passer rating during his 2019 seeing ghosts outing per nfl research despite all that minnesota s tremendous defense kept it to a one possession game until 6 17 remained a two play first quarter sequence perhaps most accurately represents how brutally wentz offset his team s defensive efforts byron murphy made a stellar interception playing center field on a josh allen end zone prayer to kill buffalo s second drive he even returned it to midfield to put wentz and co on the doorstep of field goal range instead on the very next snap wentz carelessly whipped a wide receiver screen to jefferson that went both backward and too high jefferson couldn t corral it and the bills recovered the fumble to get the ball right back that set the tone for a most disappointing day the qb position has been a massive problem for the vikings in 2026 they overcame it in their first six games but an inept offense has now cost them two straight they must fix it either in house or before the trade deadline before it s too late arrow pointing up for buffalo s defense it s been a rare occurrence this season but the bills d won them the game they completely overwhelmed minnesota and while it s fair to point to the vikings ranking 29th in yards entering week 9 it s nevertheless impressive to hold them to their fewest yards of the season even with an offense that had struggled to play its part opposite the league s best defense the vikings hadn t yet failed to eclipse 200 yards in a game they only hit 178 against the bills and that s counting a 52 yard drive led by third stringer max brosmer with the result already decided for all of the talk about minnesota s pass rush buffalo actually had a better pressure percentage against carson wentz 42 3 than the vikings did on josh allen 37 1 and did so despite blitzing on only 11 5 of wentz dropbacks antithetical to the aggressive much hyped vikes defensive approach and with better results as allen and co took time to find holes to exploit the bills defense poked them in minnesota s offensive game plan all night they allowed only nine first downs limited the vikings to five or fewer plays on 10 separate possessions and didn t give up a third down conversion buffalo s defense had allowed 28 5 points per game heading into the week 7 bye the obvious achilles heel for a team with serious super bowl aspirations the bills have now allowed 16 combined points in two games after the bye those outings were against undrafted rookie joe fagnano and wentz but this is where the foundation for a turnaround begins the confidence is building now is the time to put it to use against tougher opponents down the road bills sitting pretty in afc east the good news buffalo just rattled off its fourth straight victory besting its previous season high of a three game winning streak that began the campaign if you re waiting for the bad news there is none the rest of the afc east lost in week 9 the dolphins are now 1 7 and the jets are 2 7 six and 5 5 games back of the bills respectively which feels insurmountable given the quality of the teams and although the patriots 5 4 currently hold the head to head tiebreaker thanks to handing the bills their only loss in week 4 new england is staring at a three game deficit in the loss column with some massive issues to work through the bills still have a tough stretch ahead on the schedule playing the chiefs pats packers bears and broncos in weeks 12 16 but they also have four games remaining against the lowly jets and fins looking beyond the division history also appears to be on their side monday night marked the fifth matchup between teams tied for the nfl s best record in a november game or later over the last 15 seasons the winner of those games went on to play in the super bowl in three of four instances can the bills become the fourth such squad they re 7 1 for the first time since 1993 the last time they reached the game s biggest stage vikings head start on rest of division disappears minnesota entered week 8 as the lone unbeaten team remaining in the league after dropping two straight while the rest of the division went a collective 6 0 kevin o connell s bunch exits week 9 having officially fallen to third place in the nfc north it s only a hypothetical at this point but should the vikings fail to stop the bleeding against the packers at lambeau field this coming sunday they will plummet from the top to the bottom of the division in the span of 14 days that s how brutal the nfc north is it s currently the only division with every team sitting above 500 the sky isn t falling minnesota is a healthy 6 2 but there are problems for as incredible as the vikings defense is their offense is among the worst in the nfl their quarterback room is currently comprised of an injured underperforming kyler murray a turnover prone carson wentz who looked lost versus buffalo and max brosmer considering their next two games come on the road against the packers 6 3 and 49ers 7 1 the vikes must turn it back on soon the cushion they had is officially gone next gen stats insight for bills vikings via nfl pro josh allen was blitzed on 68 6 of his dropbacks the highest blitz rate he has faced in his career he completed 9 of 11 passes for 126 yards and a touchdown against four or fewer pass rushers nfl research the nfc north is a combined 20 4 in non division games the best such record by any division through week 9 of a season in over 40 years two of those four losses have come against the bills

material_news_signals.body_text: we re at the season s halfway point and sunday saw a number of teams and quarterbacks make loud statements as we gear up for 2026 s stretch run the nfc north continues to be an absolute buzzsaw of a division going 3 0 on sunday with the vikings set to face the bills on monday night the afc north is shaping up to be a two team race and the seahawks got back over 500 with sam darnold sidelined let s examine some key storylines in sunday s aftermath including prolific packers attack fueled by deep ball burrow marching toward first mvp another one score win for payton s broncos giants overcome adversity once again stroud s historic afternoon in los angeles but first we start with the rams who saw the return of their prized offseason acquisition and immediately reaped the benefits garrett to the rams rescue welcome back myles garrett the nfl sack champion returned from a seven game stint on injured reserve to bolster the rams pass rush which had struggled to pester signal callers without the two time defensive player of the year garrett didn t just return to the lineup on sunday no no no he blasted off like a heat seeking missile at commanders quarterback jayden daniels first there was the second quarter strip sack that set up points then in the fourth quarter garrett walloped daniels twice for two pivotal sacks that helped seal the win on a day the offense couldn t find a groove man it was a weight off my shoulders garrett said of the three sacks that helped key l a s 20 13 win in his return from september knee surgery just getting back to who i am i m nowhere near where i want to be as far as like my performance and the things i know i can do how i can move but this is a confidence booster for sure just try to boost the confidence of the guys around me as well garrett played 35 of 58 defensive snaps 60 3 in his return from injury he generated six pressures and three sacks on 27 pass rushes 22 2 pressure rate per next gen stats getting the dominant edge rusher back will also make aaron donald more menacing sunday was the first time this season that garrett and donald were active together with both on the field 23 plays the rams defense allowed 5 0 yards per play and recorded four sacks per ngs on all other plays the defense allowed 8 1 yards per play and one touchdown with zero sacks as the duo plays together more the upside is enormous garrett s return is massive for a rams squad that has struggled this season they re finally on the right side of 500 at 5 4 but still have work to do to get into playoff positioning with puka nacua s reported knee injury adding uncertainty to sean mcvay s offense the l a d might need to carry the load for the next few weeks editor s update sean mcvay told reporters monday that wr puka nacua has mcl and pcl sprains and a turf toe injury and will probably be placed on injured reserve packers air it out to demolish pats many offenses prefer to dink and dunk their way down the field executing the kind of safe approach that doesn t put the ball at risk and keeps the attack in advantageous down and distance situations and then there is green bay jordan love entered sunday already leading the league in splash plays then he dropped dime after dime after deep dime on a bewildered patriots defense in foxborough the packers qb along with burner christian watson 7 171 1 and ascending second year wideout matthew golden 10 164 1 made pats star cb christian gonzalez look like a sixth round scrub putting himself squarely in the mvp conversation love generated 372 passing yards three passing touchdowns and a regular season career high 153 2 passer rating in green bay s 45 27 shellacking of the patriots he joined aaron rodgers as the only packers quarterbacks with multiple passing touchdowns in at least eight of the first nine games of a season with rodgers doing so in 2011 and 2020 winning mvp in each of those seasons love s 153 2 passer rating in week 9 is the highest by any packers quarterback in a regular season start since rodgers had a perfect 158 3 against the raiders in 2019 it really doesn t matter who it is on defense love said after the game we trust the game plan and trust guys are gonna get open and make plays it s the nfl we see great dbs every week our mindset is we gotta keep attacking attack they did love was flawless and his deep shots were on the freaking money when he s driving the ball downfield hitting receivers in stride there isn t a prettier sight in the game right now love completed 10 of his 12 downfield pass attempts 10 air yards for 294 yards and two touchdowns against the patriots the third most downfield passing yards by a quarterback this season per next gen stats he averaged 24 5 yards pressured on nine pass attempts he completed six of those for 153 yards averaging a whopping 17 0 ypa when pressured per ngs those numbers are pure comedy but it s crazy because i know there s probably a lot more in there golden said we ve still got so many more plays out there to make there are still aspects to clean up with the offensive line still somewhat of a mess and the ground game not getting into gear until late with josh jacobs now dealing with a fractured finger the pack could use some rb help jonathan taylor anyone but when love is on the money and his two dynamic receivers aren t flubbing passes the pack can score with anyone with the lions escaping miami on sunday with a 19 9 win over the fighting fins and the bears overcoming five turnovers to best the buccaneers at home the nfc north continues to be the hottest division in the league is anyone playing better than burrow jordan love is on fire but joe burrow has been blazing for a month the bengals quarterback in sunday s 34 17 win over the falcons generated his fourth straight game with at least four passing rushing touchdowns tied for the second longest streak since 1970 behind only peyton manning s five game streak in his 2004 mvp season per nfl research over the past four tilts burrow has a thrown hilarious 16 touchdown passes while completing 77 of his passes becoming just the fourth qb fifth instance overall to pull off that feat joining tom brady 2007 manning 2013 and russell wilson 2015 and 2020 joe is playing at an unbelievably high level right now bengals head coach zac taylor said joe doesn t force the ball he takes the ball where it needs to go based on the looks and even if sometimes they re leaning into a guy or doubling a guy he s still going to give him an opportunity and some of those opportunities came up big for us so that s just something we re used to it helps to have ja 39 marr chase 10 155 1 and tee higgins 5 32 2 on your side as they did at lsu burrow and chase toasted falcons corner a j terrell with a 47 yard td bomb to get the ball rolling on a 24 point first half that all but sealed a win in madrid before the break chase was asked after the game if burrow is playing like an mvp i can t answer that because i ve been playing with him my whole life so it s kind of hard for me to sit up here and say that chase said but i ve been thinking he should have won the mvp i said this when we went to the super bowl that year and he didn t get it that year i mean he s up for it every year broncos magic in one score games continues credit sean payton s squad for continuing to come up clutch streaking to their fifth consecutive victory on sunday four of which have come by less than a touchdown sunday s 26 21 win over the panthers came after trailing by one point entering the fourth quarter the broncos fifth win of the season after trailing at any point in the fourth that ties the 2016 lions and 2022 vikings for the most wins after trailing in the fourth quarter in a team s first nine games of a season since 2000 per nfl research both the 2016 lions and 2022 vikings lost their first playoff game on wild card weekend i think it s just the character of our guys the toughness competitiveness of our guys broncos quarterback bo nix said after the game we re just comfortable in that moment when things get close there at the end of the game whatever it is we have had a couple scores and then we always want to make it one score just glad we re on this side and winning em the broncos jumped out to a 10 0 advantage before the panthers got back in the game and took a third quarter lead carolina controlled the middle portion of the game but nix and co took over late with two fourth quarter touchdown drives capped by a 26 yard strike from nix to pat bryant after the offense failed to get a game sealing first down late the defense stepped up and forced a fumble to squash the panthers final drive i just think we ve been there before so we know how to handle the situation nik bonitto who had the game sealing strip sack of bryce young said at the end of the day it was our job as a defense to just go out and finish the victory set an nfl record with their 16th consecutive regular season win in a one score contest broncos games are rarely normal sunday s included a miraculous interception in the end zone that took a replay review of when payton s challenge flag was thrown before it could be reviewed we could say the magic will eventually run out and the broncos will regress to the mean in one score games however there have been enough of them to admit it s part of the makeup of payton s broncos maybe it will never be pretty but that win column sure looks nice right now for the 7 2 squad harbaugh s giants keep finding ways to win it s not just that john harbaugh has guided the giants to the top of the nfc east with a 5 2 1 record it s how they ve morphed into a reliable steady team that stands in stark contrast to the past decade plus of ineptitude for the most part the giants haven t beaten themselves sure there was cam skattebo s fumble against washington that led to a week 5 tie and jameis winston s early turnover barrage in their week 6 loss to new orleans but big blue has become better at not letting things unravel on sunday against a reeling eagles squad in a place lincoln financial field that has been a bugaboo for new york for a dozen years things could have spiraled out of control particularly when j j mccarthy exited due to a hip injury instead winston entered and calmly converted a third down and a fourth down to lead the giants only td drive of the game he then handed the reins back to mccarthy who finished out the win it was a prime example of all 46 active players doing their part to secure a victory perhaps more important than the offense doing just enough is a defense coming on strong under coordinator dennard wilson in previous years new york s offensive struggles got most of the attention despite the fact that the limp d had been equally or more disappointing given the up front talent under wilson this unit is a bullying menace stopping a sleepy eagles offense that saw joe milton start his first career game on sunday isn t anything to write home about on the surface but how new york did it is very noteworthy most notable arvell reese was a dominant force the rookie earned a career high three sacks and led the giants with 12 tackles becoming the first rookie since at least 1994 to record three sacks and at least 10 tackles in a game per nfl research reese joins fellow top five pick david bailey of the jets as the only rookies with at least three sacks in a game this season defensive rookie of the year that s set in stone cornerback greg newsome said of reece per the new york daily news now we re looking at defensive player of the year the superlatives for the rookie linebacker are just starting i don t know any young players that can do the things he does i m gonna be honest with you veteran defensive tackle d j reader said maybe the kid in seattle no 3 nick emmanwori because you don t find a kid that can cover the way he can cover come down and fill gaps in the run game rush the passer doesn t miss tackles kid s serious man it s special to watch he s really special the offense will come and go especially if the rushing attack is slowed like sunday but if big blue can rest its hat on a defense led by a dynamic rookie linebacker the giants can still run away with the nfc east week 9 sunday spotlight

material_news_signals.headline: Agent: Brandon Aiyuk plans to play this season, likely with 'somebody that knows him'
material_news_signals.body_text: brandon aiyuk 39 s agent said tuesday he 39 s confident the receiver will play this season and that he thinks aiyuk will wind up 34 with a team that knows him that has somehow been affiliated with him either in college or with the 49ers 34 on 34 the pat mcafee show 34 drew rosenhaus said aiyuk met with 49ers general manager john lynch among others in santa clara last week and that he passed a physical 34 with flying colors 34 34 he had an mri he had x rays he had a physical exam 34 rosenhaus said of aiyuk who had a multiligament knee injury in october 2024 and has not played since 34 he 39 s working out on his own he 39 s running routes he 39 s catching footballs he says he 39 s 100 percent ready to play we 39 d be glad to go work out for interested teams if he is released by the 49ers 34 the nfl reinstated aiyuk on monday and granted the 49ers a two week unpaid roster exemption for the receiver aiyuk is not expected to be with the team during that period and the 49ers have until nov 23 to cut him the expected outcome both lynch and coach kyle shanahan have said the team 39 s relationship with aiyuk is over after he didn 39 t properly rehabilitate from his knee injury and then stopped coming into the facility during the 2025 season on monday shanahan shrugged off questions about aiyuk 39 s reinstatement 34 it means absolutely nothing to our team 34 he said 34 i think we 39 ve got a two week roster exemption that 39 s all administrative stuff to me 34 the 49ers are trying to recoup at least a portion of the roughly 13 million aiyuk owes for failing to uphold the contract extension he signed in 2024 something rosenhaus characterized as a separate issue from him getting back on the field 34 as far as the money that 39 s allegedly owed the 13 million whatever it is he hasn 39 t paid anything yet 34 he said 34 that 39 s something that we 39 ll work out separate and distinct from the issue of him playing hopefully we 39 ll work something out to the benefit of brandon 39 s and something that 39 s fair and that 39 s also part of my job 34 though he characterized it as a guess rosenhaus said he thought aiyuk would land with a team already familiar with the receiver that strongly points to the washington commanders whose general manager adam peters helped draft aiyuk in san francisco in 2020 and whose quarterback jayden daniels is friends with aiyuk from their playing days at arizona state aiyuk also purchased property in northern virginia not far from the commanders 39 practice facility 34 you see people connect the dots where they have history where there 39 s relationships 34 rosenhaus said 34 i don 39 t know where yet but that 39 s just my assumption that something like that could happen a former coach maybe a former player that played with him somebody that knows him 34 aiyuk spent the offseason berating the 49ers including lynch saying he 39 d never do business with them and otherwise severing ties through bitter sometimes unhinged social media posts on tuesday rosenhaus tried to mend the damage the receiver had done to his image over the last year 34 i think he 39 s in a really good place 34 he said 34 he met with the 49ers he did a good job in the meeting with them he said hello to john lynch he met with the team i just feel like he 39 s in a good place and getting to know him over the last week i 39 m confident in his future moving forward 34 this article originally appeared in the athletic

material_news_signals.headline: Jaguars acquire Eagles DT Jordan Davis in blockbuster trade
material_news_signals.description: The Jaguars are trading for Eagles defensive tackle Jordan Davis, sending a 2027 first-round pick and a 2029 second-round pick to Philadelphia, the teams announced on Monday.
material_news_signals.body_text: the jacksonville jaguars are going all in on a super bowl push the jags are trading for eagles defensive tackle jordan davis sending a 2027 first round pick and a 2029 second round selection to philadelphia the teams announced on monday the deal marks the third trade for a defensive player of the day for the jaguars after acquiring falcons safety jessie bates and saints defensive tackle davon godchaux it s a stunning flurry of moves from jaguars general manager james gladstone who surrendered tremendous draft capital five total picks including a first and two seconds to revamp his team s defense a day before the league s trade deadline the moves on monday were made to combat the season ending injuries to starting safety eric murray and defensive tackle davon hamilton with godchaux and davis providing a new interior tandem for defensive coordinator anthony campanile davis the no 12 overall pick in the 2022 draft has 31 tackles 1 5 sacks two tackles for loss and three qb hits in nine games this season davis excels as a dynamic space eater in the middle his 23 run stops are second in the league among dts and his 28 run tackles are tied for fourth per next gen stats in 2025 davis totaled 63 run tackles and 50 run stops which were both second among defensive tackles it shows that the jaguars 6 2 believe they are well positioned for a title run in an afc where they began monday jostling for playoff positioning with the one loss bills and a host of fellow two loss teams broncos chiefs steelers and bengals for the eagles the decision to move on from davis further underscores that it is a lost season in philly we are extremely grateful to jordan for his contributions to our team on the field and in the philadelphia community since we drafted him five years ago the eagles said in a statement he has been a key contributor to our team culture and on field success which included two super bowl appearances and a world championship in 2024 his growth and development as both a player and a leader are a testament to his hard work and character we wish jordan nothing but continued success the eagles lost 19 11 on sunday to the giants for their seventh consecutive loss to fall to 2 7 on the season four of those losses have come without jalen hurts who is expected to miss the rest of the season due to blood clots and third year signal caller joe milton took over starting duties in sunday s loss for tanner mckee

material_news_signals.description: The Chiefs are acquiring Josh Downs and a 2027 seventh-round pick from the Colts in exchange for a 2027 fourth-round selection and a 2027 fifth-rounder, NFL Network Insider Ian Rapoport and ESPN's Adam Schefter reported on Tuesday.
material_news_signals.body_text: josh downs wish has been granted and a need has been answered in kansas city the chiefs are acquiring the slot receiver in a trade with the colts nfl network insider ian rapoport and espn s adam schefter reported kansas city is sending fourth and fifth round picks in the 2027 draft to indianapolis in the deal while receiving a 2027 seventh round pick in exchange per rapoport and schefter indianapolis announced the trade shortly after downs becomes the fourth player traded by the colts prior to tuesday s deadline joining the likes of guard quenton nelson defensive tackle deforest buckner and fellow receiver keenan allen who was traded to san francisco earlier tuesday i am beyond grateful and blessed for my time in indy downs wrote on social media following news of the trade nothing but love for the shoe a third round pick out of north carolina in 2023 downs became a reliable secondary receiving option in indianapolis pairing with michael pittman and eventually alec pierce to form a quality pass catching tandem for the colts despite instability under center he posted a career high 803 receiving yards and five touchdowns in 14 games in 2024 but watched indianapolis trade pittman to pittsburgh and hand pierce the lucrative extension downs desired over the offseason leaving downs in an awkward spot entering a contract year that contract year became a nightmare for the colts prompting downs to request a trade following two deals that shipped nelson to seattle and buckner to san francisco indianapolis didn t initially adhere to his request and coach shane steichen convinced downs to continue participating following the receiver s ask to be dealt but after two games played the colts decided it was time to maximize whatever return was available for the receiver especially as free agency loomed in early 2027 downs heads to kansas city to join a receiver room that is headlined by rashee rice who returned from injury in week 8 and helped improve kansas city s passing attack but is short at the position following xavier worthy s hamstring injury suffered in the chiefs week 9 win over the new york jets and if we re being honest the chiefs have long needed help at receiver making them a likely candidate to swing a deal for a receiver even before worthy s latest injury with downs now in the mix patrick mahomes will have another option to turn to as he surveys the field indianapolis meanwhile concludes a remarkably active trade window in which they dealt four players but held onto the most recognizable one running back jonathan taylor when the colts fired general manager chris ballard and sent out expiring mainstays like nelson and buckner it was clear the organization was willing to engage in a fire sale in order to jump start a rebuild as a star runner at nearly 28 years old taylor was seen as the most valuable asset in such a teardown and was understandably attracting plenty of interest from rb needy contenders despite these market forces encouraging a blockbuster trade when the 4 p m et deadline passed on tuesday taylor remained a colt indianapolis will finish 2026 with taylor remaining at the center of its offense and perhaps entertain a trade following the conclusion of the current campaign

material_news_signals.body_text: minnesota has its new and old quarterback the vikings are acquiring kirk cousins from the las vegas raiders in exchange for a 2027 third round draft pick nfl network insiders ian rapoport and mike garafolo and espn s adam schefter reported on tuesday minnesota has since announced the trade the swap also begins the fernando mendoza era for the raiders as the 2026 nfl draft s no 1 overall pick will now take over as the team s starter raiders general manager john spytek told reporters that he didn t expect to trade cousins and didn t make calls to shop him before minnesota reached out tuesday morning this was a hard decision spytek said of moving cousins per team reporter paul gutierrez but we felt like we made the best decision for the raiders going forward the trade brings cousins 38 back to the club he played for from 2018 to 2023 and reunites him with head coach kevin o connell who was in charge for cousins final two years as a viking cousins first season under o connell was one of his finest as a pro as he threw for 4 547 yards 29 touchdowns and 14 interceptions while going 13 4 in 2022 minnesota will desperately be hoping for more of the same from cousins after its qb situation disintegrated to a point that it was threatening to tank the team s season despite the vikings boasting the top scoring defense in the league a relentless pressure machine that batters opponents and keeps them off the scoreboard the offense has been a travesty that unit ranks 27th in points 31st in yards and 31st in passing the vikings have scored 16 points or less in five of their eight games including the last three it hasn t mattered if kyler murray or carson wentz was under center and j j mccarthy drafted to take over for cousins in 2024 flunked out of o connell s quarterback school and was traded to the giants on sept 28 thus cousins returns to replace his replacement the four time pro bowler has played remarkably well for las vegas this season more than just a placeholder for mendoza he s thrown for 2 340 yards 20 touchdowns and eight interceptions while leading the raiders to a 4 5 record a much better spot than most would have predicted and on the playoff bubble midway through the season mendoza now takes over for the silver and black hoping to keep them competitive down the stretch and prove himself worthy of being the top pick in the 2026 draft a heisman trophy winner and national champion at indiana mendoza has made one prior appearance this season entering a blowout loss to the patriots and throwing for 48 yards on 6 of 8 passing he s shown us he s ready not only physically but mentally spytek said after officially naming mendoza as las vegas starter beginning with sunday s upcoming game versus a seahawks squad sporting a stingy defense raiders head coach klint kubiak added i anticipate it being a transition we re going to find out together the future is now for the raiders while a blast from the past returns to the vikings hoping to rescue an offense in dire need of saving if cousins proves ready to play in week 10 he ll face off against the packers at lambeau field just as he did in has last game with the vikings back in 2023

material_news_signals.body_text: we re at the season s halfway point and sunday saw a number of teams and quarterbacks make loud statements as we gear up for 2026 s stretch run the nfc north continues to be an absolute buzzsaw of a division going 3 0 on sunday with the vikings set to face the bills on monday night the afc north is shaping up to be a two team race and the seahawks got back over 500 with sam darnold sidelined let s examine some key storylines in sunday s aftermath including prolific packers attack fueled by deep ball burrow marching toward first mvp another one score win for payton s broncos giants overcome adversity once again stroud s historic afternoon in los angeles but first we start with the rams who saw the return of their prized offseason acquisition and immediately reaped the benefits garrett to the rams rescue welcome back myles garrett the nfl sack champion returned from a seven game stint on injured reserve to bolster the rams pass rush which had struggled to pester signal callers without the two time defensive player of the year garrett didn t just return to the lineup on sunday no no no he blasted off like a heat seeking missile at commanders quarterback jayden daniels first there was the second quarter strip sack that set up points then in the fourth quarter garrett walloped daniels twice for two pivotal sacks that helped seal the win on a day the offense couldn t find a groove man it was a weight off my shoulders garrett said of the three sacks that helped key l a s 20 13 win in his return from september knee surgery just getting back to who i am i m nowhere near where i want to be as far as like my performance and the things i know i can do how i can move but this is a confidence booster for sure just try to boost the confidence of the guys around me as well garrett played 35 of 58 defensive snaps 60 3 in his return from injury he generated six pressures and three sacks on 27 pass rushes 22 2 pressure rate per next gen stats getting the dominant edge rusher back will also make aaron donald more menacing sunday was the first time this season that garrett and donald were active together with both on the field 23 plays the rams defense allowed 5 0 yards per play and recorded four sacks per ngs on all other plays the defense allowed 8 1 yards per play and one touchdown with zero sacks as the duo plays together positioning with puka nacua s reported knee injury adding uncertainty to sean mcvay s offense the l a d might need to carry the load for the next few weeks editor s update sean mcvay told reporters monday that wr puka nacua has mcl and pcl sprains and a turf toe injury and will probably be placed on injured reserve packers air it out to demolish pats many offenses prefer to dink and dunk their way down the field executing the kind of safe approach that doesn t put the ball at risk and keeps the attack in advantageous down and distance situations and then there is green bay jordan love entered sunday already leading the league in splash plays then he dropped dime after dime after deep dime on a bewildered patriots defense in foxborough the packers qb along with burner christian watson 7 171 1 and ascending second year wideout matthew golden 10 164 1 made pats star cb christian gonzalez look like a sixth round scrub putting himself squarely in the mvp conversation love generated 372 passing yards three passing touchdowns and a regular season career high 153 2 passer rating in green bay s 45 27 shellacking of the patriots he joined aaron rodgers as the only packers quarterbacks with multiple passing touchdowns in at least eight of the first nine games of a season with rodgers doing so in 2011 and 2020 winning mvp in each of those seasons love s 153 2 passer rating in week 9 is the highest by any packers quarterback in a regular season start since rodgers had a perfect 158 3 against the raiders in 2019 it really doesn t matter who it is on defense love said after the game we trust the game plan and trust guys are gonna get open and make plays it s the nfl we see great dbs every week our mindset is we gotta keep attacking attack they did love was flawless and his deep shots were on the freaking money when he s driving the ball downfield hitting receivers in stride there isn t a prettier sight in the game right now love completed 10 of his 12 downfield pass attempts 10 air yards for 294 yards and two touchdowns against the patriots the third most downfield passing yards by a quarterback this season per next gen stats he averaged 24 5 yards per attempt on those downfield passes the fifth most in a single game since 2018 he completed six of his eight deep attempts 20 air yards for 235 yards and one touchdown better still love was pressured on nine pass attempts he completed six of those for 153 yards averaging a whopping 17 0 ypa when pressured per ngs those numbers are pure comedy but it s crazy because i know there s probably a lot more in there golden said we ve still got so many more plays out there to make there are still aspects to clean up with the offensive line still somewhat of a mess and the ground game not getting into gear until late with josh jacobs now dealing with a fractured finger the pack could use some rb help jonathan taylor anyone but when love is on the money and his two dynamic receivers aren t flubbing passes the pack can score with anyone with the lions escaping miami on sunday with a 19 9 win over the fighting fins and the bears overcoming five turnovers to best the buccaneers at home the nfc north continues to be the hottest division in the league is anyone playing better than burrow jordan love is on fire but joe burrow has been blazing for a month the bengals quarterback in sunday s 34 17 win over the falcons generated his fourth straight game with at least four passing rushing touchdowns tied for the second longest streak since 1970 behind only peyton manning s five game streak in his 2004 mvp season per nfl research over the past four tilts burrow has a thrown hilarious 16 touchdown passes while completing 77 of his passes becoming just the fourth qb fifth instance overall to pull off that feat joining tom brady 2007 manning 2013 and russell wilson 2015 and 2020 joe is playing at an unbelievably high level right now bengals head coach zac taylor said joe doesn t force the ball he takes the ball where it needs to go based on the looks and even if sometimes they re leaning into a guy or doubling a guy he s still going to give him an opportunity and some of those opportunities came up big for us so that s just something we re used to it helps to have ja 39 marr chase 10 155 1 and tee higgins 5 32 2 on your side as they did at lsu burrow and chase toasted falcons corner a j terrell with a 47 yard td bomb to get the ball rolling on a 24 point first half that all but sealed a win in madrid before the break chase was asked after the game if burrow is playing like an mvp i can t answer that because i ve been playing with him my whole life so it s kind of hard for me to sit up here and say that chase said but i ve been thinking he should have won the mvp i said this when we went to the super bowl that year and he didn t get it that year i mean he s up for it every year broncos magic in one score games continues credit sean payton s squad for continuing to come up clutch streaking to their fifth consecutive victory on sunday four of which have come by less than a touchdown sunday s 26 21 win over the panthers came after trailing by one point entering the fourth quarter the broncos fifth win of the season after trailing at any point in the fourth that ties the 2016 lions and 2022 vikings for the most wins after trailing in the fourth
